scope: New Hampshire Family Law LLM v8.0.10 prelaunch
status_meaning: Every blocker is evidence-based. A missing receipt is never a passing gate.

blockers.reproduction: Run the 37-target official-source acquisition audit against the preserved r2 data root.
blockers.expected_behavior: Every configured authority target has an authentic original, currentness evidence, and an approved promotion record.
blockers.actual_behavior: 33 original official responses were retained; NH-0028 through NH-0031 returned HTTP 404 and remain unpromoted.
blockers.remediation: Identify and acquire current official rule publications, then perform source identity, extraction, proposition, and currentness review before promotion.
blockers.owner_dependency: Independent qualified New Hampshire legal reviewer for promotion decisions.

blockers.affected_feature: RSA 461-A:6 current-law answers on and after 2026-09-13
blockers.reproduction: Ask a present-law question requiring the pending-amendment capsule on or after the effective date.
blockers.expected_behavior: A current, reviewed replacement may support the proposition; stale text may not.
blockers.actual_behavior: The application fails closed rather than using the stale capsule. No reviewed replacement is promoted.
blockers.remediation: Preserve fresh primary source and session-law material, verify applicability and effective interval, and obtain qualified review before explicit activation.
blockers.owner_dependency: Independent qualified New Hampshire legal reviewer.

blockers.reproduction: Inspect the true-GA tracker and legal-review evidence auditor.
blockers.expected_behavior: Release claims require digest-bound, scope-limited independent legal review evidence.
blockers.actual_behavior: Zero of 33 true-GA passes is verified; no attorney sign-off is represented.
blockers.remediation: Complete the reviewer packet, collect decisions against exact digests, and rerun the independent evidence audit.
blockers.owner_dependency: Qualified New Hampshire attorney or appropriately authorized legal reviewer.

blockers.reproduction: Run installed-package, accessibility, upgrade, and clean-machine qualification for the exact submission MSIX.
blockers.expected_behavior: A real installed MSIX passes supported-user, accessibility, lifecycle, and offline checks with preserved receipts.
blockers.actual_behavior: Frozen runtime checks pass, but installed MSIX, clean-machine, upgrade/uninstall, and OS-level zero-network evidence are not complete.
blockers.remediation: Install a separately labeled test package in a supported Windows test environment and preserve non-sensitive qualification receipts.
blockers.owner_dependency: Windows test environment and owner authorization for test installation/trust changes when required.

blockers.reproduction: Run Store preflight for the r7 MSIX and inspect identity configuration.
blockers.expected_behavior: Exact Partner Center identity is confirmed and package qualification/WACK evidence is attached.
blockers.actual_behavior: The unsigned package is prepared, but production identity confirmation, WACK, Store submission, and Microsoft certification receipts are absent.
blockers.remediation: Confirm the owner-controlled Partner Center identity, run WACK for the exact package, and complete submission only with separate owner authorization.
blockers.owner_dependency: Owner-controlled Partner Center account and Microsoft external review.
